# Checklist

Please confirm the following before submitting this feature request.

- [ ] I have searched existing Issues and Discussions.
- [ ] I have reviewed the project documentation.
- [ ] This proposal aligns with the long-term engineering direction of Limoxel.
- [ ] This proposal extends the platform rather than redesigning the engineering foundation.

---

# Maintainer Review

Limoxel follows a maintainer approval model.

Feature requests are evaluated according to:

- Engineering Principles
- Architectural Consistency
- Repository Organization
- Long-Term Roadmap
- Engineering Complexity
- Implementation Feasibility
- Long-Term Maintainability

Submission of a feature request does not guarantee implementation.

A proposal may be:

- Accepted
- Scheduled for a future milestone
- Deferred pending further discussion
- Declined if it conflicts with the engineering direction of the project

For significant architectural proposals or if you are unsure whether a feature aligns with the project's long-term vision, please contact:

**hello.limoxel@gmail.com**

before investing significant implementation effort.

Thank you for helping improve Limoxel.
